$comment: Strings that must never appear in src/** (testdocs/ and *.test.* excepted). The point is that the app cannot know anything about the bundled demo document: if a term from it shows up in app code, someone hardcoded content instead of reading the Doc. Only include terms that are IDENTIFYING — a phrase is excluded when it is also ordinary UI or engineering vocabulary ('table of contents', 'one source of truth', 'composition root'), because those produce false alarms that train people to ignore this check. Extend it when a new demo document is added; never trim it to make a failure go away.
